text: 2026-08-03 source-confirmed semantic slice: added CoefficientScope with SharedAcrossRuns, RunSpecific, and SeparateRunsThenFixedEffects (explicitly marked non-executable); FitStrategy now exposes coefficientScope and FitPlan/FitSummary carry it. Existing RunwiseLeastSquares maps to RunSpecific and all other executable strategies map to SharedAcrossRuns without changing solver behavior. ModelSuite and ChunkedRunwiseExecutionScenarioSuite assert the scope on JVM+JS. Separate/fixed-effects combination, run-scoped task ColumnOrigin, and cross-run hypothesis lowering remain open; this slice intentionally does not claim them.
